class_imbalance_decision_2.strategy: Dynamic Negative Subsampling + Binary Focal Loss

rationale: Strategy B (overlap_ratio >= 0.50) selected as primary because: (1) 100% event coverage (198/198, 0 missed); (2) >= 3 positive windows for every event including shortest 6.0s seizures; (3) Eliminates 315 boundary-contaminated windows (60-90% background); (4) 4,684 high-purity positive anchors (91.55% pure ictal content); (5) Integrates with frozen 10:1 subsampler and Binary Focal Loss. Strategy A retained for sensitivity ablation.
